evidence: script-installed-root-executable: user_kde_lock_screen_common.pp:8-12 declares the file in bindir with owner root, group root, mode 0755; filesystem::bindir resolves on the master to /opt/puppet-infrastructure/bin, so stat '%U %G %a' expecting 'root root 755' tests exactly those lines

lock-settings-in-the-users-kscreenlockerrc (configure_lock_screen.sh:66-95): the script writes Autolock=true, LockOnResume=true, Timeout=$1 and LockGrace=$2 under [Daemon] of $HOME/.config/kscreenlockerrc, running as the user (exec user => title); the probe reads those four keys of p8testuser's file plus its owner, and the expected values follow from those lines with the fixture's arguments 2 and 0

lock-settings-in-the-users-kscreenlockerrc (user_kde_lock_screen.pp:5-6): the defaults are timeout 5 and grace 0; the params fixture {screenlock_timeout_minutes: 2} overrides only the timeout, so Timeout=2 and LockGrace=0 are what the code produces

purpose covered: The stated purpose (enforce the user's KDE screen lock: idle lock after the timeout, lock on resume, grace, applied to the user's own settings and reloaded live on each agent run while logged in, so a user who disables it gets it back) matches the header ('updates the screen locker settings for a specific user') and the baseline define plus script. Tested on kubuntu with a real Plasma login: the root-owned 0755 script, the skip note when the harness ran with the user logged out, the four settings in the user's kscreenlockerrc, the logged-in note with no D-Bus fallback (live reload worked), the idle session actually locking 120-290 s after login (measured contrast: no lock within 450 s without the class), and the user turning Autolock off (still unlocked 150 s later) then the node's agent run restoring Autolock=true and the session locking. Uncovered, honestly: the grace period's effect (needs input injection; I confirmed xdotool, ydotool, xte, wtype and evemu-event are all missing on p8lab-kubuntu); lock on resume (the runner has no suspend step and holds a sleep inhibitor; LockOnResume=true itself is checked in the file); other timeout/grace values (one params fixture per set). Not in the table and not needed for the purpose: the 16.04 kwriteconfig branch (Ubuntu 24.04 only) and the D-Bus-unavailable fallback (a degraded path; the checks assert it did not trigger).
